SCHOOL OF COMMUNICATION STUDIES
Walk-in Interview
Walk-in ~terviews for appointment of two posts of Guest Faculty, Even-semester, Academic Session
202~-24 m the School of Communication Studies (SCS) will be held on 12.04.2024 in the office of the
Chairperson, as per the schedule given below:-
S.No. Reporting Date & Time
I • Submission of Application* on plain paper 12.04.2024
• Verification of Documents 10:00 am - 11:00 am
2 Interview 12.04.2024
11 :30 am onwards
*Application Format:
Sr.No. Details
I. Name
2. Date of Birth
3. Educational qualifications (with percentage from 10th onwards)
4. Attested photocopy of MA degree
5. Teaching and other work experience (attach details)
6. Research experience (attach details)
7. Publications (attach details)
8. Projects completed and on11:oing (attach details)
9. Awards
10. Other aualifications/skills
11. Correspondence and permanent address
12. Mob.No./Email-id
Eligibility Criteria:
Essential qualifications as per UGC & PU Guidelines: MA in Journalism & Mass Communication or
equivalent with good academic record as defined by the concerned university wil)t at least 55% marks
(50% marks in case of SC/ST/Physically Handicapped/Visually Handicapped) or an equivalent grade
•
..
at the Masters degree level.
Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility
Test (NET) conducted by the UGC in Journalism & Mass Communication or must fulfill the other
UGC regulations for recruitment and appointment of Assistant Professor or equivalent positions in
the University/College/Institute.
Desirable qualifications: Working knowledge of editing and design software (Quark Xpress,
Core!Draw, Final Cut Pro (FCP), Adobe etc.); Video Camera handling.
Honorarium and work details:
• The post is on purely temporary/contract basis with a salary/honorarium of Rs.1500/- per lecture with
an upper limit of Rs. 50000/- per month consolidated.
• Working hours will be from 9.00 a.m. to 5.00 p.m, Monday to Friday.
• Classes/subjects to be taught will be as per requirement.
Note:1. All the applicants are advised to bring their original certificates and other relevant documents for
verification along with the duly filled a~lication form strictly between 10:00 am and 11 :00 am. No
walk-ins will be entertained once the interview process commences.
2. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates appear1ng for the interview.
3. Queries can be addressed at scsoffice7@gmail.com0r at Ol 72-2541982.
4. Applicants are advised to check the Notice Board of SCS https://scs.puchd.ac.in/show-
noticeboard.phb?nbid= 1for updates.
